title: Melnikov Analysis of Deterministic and Stochastic Manifold Splitting in the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky Equation
summary: We develop a Melnikov framework for the Kuramoto Sivashinsky (KS) equation under weak deterministic and stochastic forcing. By treating KS as an infinite dimensional dynamical system, we derive a Melnikov functional that measures splitting of stable and unstable manifolds of a homoclinic orbit. Periodic forcing leads to phase dependent transverse intersections, while stochastic forcing produces random manifold splitting characterized by a variance determined by the adjoint solution.
